notes: FROZEN. A label is never changed because a resolver fails it. Any correction needs a version bump, a recorded reason, evidence and a separate review.
Every label is justified by ground_truth_evidence: citations to recorded source fields, verified on load.
Group totals are 62 positive, 85 negative, 33 quarantine, 20 new entity. The category distribution is the approved, evidence-driven one; see dropped[] for what could not be grounded.
18 positive cases carry masked_evidence: the Steam app id link proves the label but is withheld from the resolver, wherever it appears, so the resolver must decide from the remaining evidence.
Cases marked truth=difficult have an expected decision that reflects the evidence available, not certainty about the underlying fact.
Version 2 (2026-10-05): split evidence into ground-truth and masked; Counter-Strike case reworded as current-state; FiveM expected decision set to manual_override.
